The '''K-52 Strongarm''', also known as '''K-52 Demolisher''', was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] model produced by [[Hyrotii Corporation/Legends|Hyrotii Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] and sold to customers all over the galaxy without question. One such ship was purchased by [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Marr]], which soon made it popular with other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial military]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. It was also popular with privateers, mercenaries and other non-military sources that loaned their services to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The K-52, referred to as "Strongarm" for Republic players and "Demolisher" for Imperial players, was introduced in the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' as a Premium ship, available only through the Cartel Market. Functionally, it is identical to the [[SGS-41B Comet Breaker]]/[[GSS-5C Dustmaker]].
